prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Is Your Pet Visible on Desktop?", "Look around your screen! If your companion is hidden behind windows, use Alt+Tab or check your system tray.", "Check behind active windows", "My Pet Is Here!"]
1: []
2: ["Listen to Your Companion", "Test how your desktop pet sounds when greeting you or reacting to your actions.", "Play Greeting Sound"]
3: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "Right-click your pet anytime to bring up quick actions, or press your hotkey to invoke them instantly."]
4: ["Signing in ensures your desktop pet memory, customization, and progress are backed up automatically."]
5: ["Using multiple monitors? Your pet will appear on your primary screen by default."]
6: ["Choose Your Primary Companion Archetype"]
7: ["What Can Your Desktop Pet Do?", "Your companion lives directly on your desktop, responding to your workflow, keeping you focused, and playing mini-games.", "Desktop Overlay", "Continue"]
8: []
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your personalized companion has been registered to your device and desktop environment."]
